description: ALFOSC (Andalucia Faint Object Spectrograph and Camera) is the primary optical instrument on the 2.56-meter Nordic Optical Telescope (NOT), providing imaging in Bessell, interference, and SDSS filters.
facility_description: The Nordic Optical Telescope (NOT) is a 2.56-meter optical/infrared telescope located at Roque de los Muchachos Observatory on La Palma, Canary Islands.
notes: Filter-only transmissions from the NOT filter database (filter numbers as listed there for the ALFOSC set-ups). Telescope, detector and atmosphere are not included.
